answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond at a mesa post and files a prism proof, a sample split by a prism table into facets only its key makes. A gale beacon posts a bounty: proof of a rented or copied proof wins the faker's bond. Auditors re-split each proof; identical facets on two claims burn both bonds of a rented-prism ring. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 x 100 = 100,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 60,000 loss. Honest agents file once, pay 30, keep the bond.
